newsitem.title: USA: Health Fitness Corp unit sells clinics.
newsitem.headline: Health Fitness Corp unit sells clinics.

text.p: Health Fitness Corp, a preventive and rehabilitative care company, said Wednesday its Health Fitness Rehab Inc unit has completed the sale of its seven California-based outpatient clinic operations to Regency Outpatient Services Inc.

The price included about $1.1 million in cash and $1.1 million accounts receivable paid at closing, a $370,000 note to be paid quarterly over three years and assumption by Regency of a $330,000 note issued in connection with Health Fitness's acquisition of four of the clinics.

"While we were not actively seeking a sale of these clinics, the opportunity was good for all parties involved and will allow (Health Fitness) to focus on its acquisition strategy in less competitive markets," Health Fitness president Thomas Coplin said in a news release.
Health Fitness shares closed up 1/32 at 2-3/4 Wednesday.
